title: aico-hook payloads
description: What each tool hands aico-hook (native/hook) on stdin and what it prints back. Claude Code and Codex run `aico-hook claude` / `aico-hook codex` as a command hook; the Pi extension (native/hook/pi/aico-hook.ts) builds the same Claude-style payload from Pi's events and runs `aico-hook pi`; Aico's agent harness (packages/agent) runs `aico-hook guard` before each shell command. stdin is one JSON object (`input`); stdout is one JSON object (`output`); the exit code is always 0. Only a guard decision denies. A crash or missing data answers a `context` output that says plainly what went unchecked, never a silent allow and never a block. Fields beyond those listed may be present and are ignored. `examples` are replayed by native/hook/main_test.go: `{repo}` is a fresh git checkout, `output` names the $defs output the answer must match.

events.PreToolUse: matcher Bash|mcp__.*(?:github|git).*|Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit: the guard, then the shell snapshot or the edit lease
events.PostToolUse: matcher Bash: shell-write overlap and the GitHub PAT hint
events.SessionStart: the identity registry, SummitFlow's startup brief, publication enforcement status, context delivery

events.SubagentStart: as claude; agent_id is the worker's identity

codex.trust: Codex runs a hook only once trusted: `aico-hook codex-trust` marks the hooks of ~/.codex/hooks.json trusted through Codex's own hooks/list + config/batchWrite

events.PreToolUse: tool_call for bash, edit, write and GitHub connector tools; a deny blocks the call, context is appended to the tool result
events.SessionStart: session_start; context goes into the system prompt

events.PreToolUse: the guard only; anything but {} or a deny is treated as a deny by packages/agent

x-invocations.context-delivery: SessionStart and SubagentStart run the command in native/hook/data/hook.json context.command (empty = the stub that delivers nothing) as `<command> --tool <claude-code|codex|pi> --session S --format <claude|codex|pi> --event E [--project P]`, contracts/context-delivery.schema.json, and fold its text into additionalContext

session_id.description: the tool's session id (Pi: PI_SESSION_ID); the lease identity

tool_name.description: Bash, exec_command, bash (Pi), Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, apply_patch, edit, write (Pi), mcp__* connectors

tool_input.description: an object for every known tool: command (Bash), cmd (exec_command), file_path / notebook_path / path (edits), command or input holding the patch (apply_patch)

tool_use_id.description: keys the shell snapshot between PreToolUse and PostToolUse

tool_response.description: the tool's result (read for the GitHub PAT 403)

source.description: startup, resume, clear or compact; clear and compact keep the identity, startup resets its continuing line

UserPromptSubmit.description: not routed to aico-hook yet: the coordination inbox stays on SummitFlow's coord-inbox hook until the sessions/handshake rebuild (M10a); aico-hook answers {}

additionalContext.description: lines the agent reads: lease warnings, overlap, notices, crash notes, delivered context

tool_input.command:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: {repo}/a.txt
@@
-a
+b
*** End Patch
